name: push-to-talk-dictation
description: Fast, accurate push-to-talk dictation for Claude Code on Windows: hold Right Ctrl, talk, release. Streams to OpenAI gpt-live-transcribe; text lands about half a second after you stop.

hotkey.title: Push-to-talk key
hotkey.description: Hold to dictate, release to insert; tap to go hands-free. Works while Claude is not focused.

microphone.title: Microphone
microphone.description: Part of the input device's name (for example 'USB' or 'Headset'); empty uses the Windows default.

languages.title: Languages
languages.description: Comma-separated ISO codes you dictate in, for example 'en' or 'en, fr'.

vocabulary.title: Vocabulary hints
vocabulary.description: Comma-separated words and names the transcriber should expect.
vocabulary.default: Claude, Claude Code, Anthropic, OpenAI, TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Node.js, npm, pytest, git, GitHub, README, Docker, Kubernetes, React, JSON, YAML, API, CLI

latency.title: Transcription latency
latency.description: Lower shows words sooner; higher waits for more context.

liveText.title: Show words while you speak
liveText.description: Off: the text lands once you finish, like Claude's own mic. On: words stream into the prompt as you talk, dimmed until final.

showIdleBar.title: Show the dictation bar when idle
showIdleBar.description: A one-line hint and Dictate button above the prompt while not dictating.
